title: Who tested this recipe?

scenes.heading: You found a recipe. Who tested it?
scenes.sub: Look beyond the presence of a recipe file.
voice: A recipe fits the cluster you want to build.
Before relying on it, look for what has been tested and which environments supplied those results.
scenes.result: Find the evidence behind the recipe

scenes.heading: Separate simulation and real hardware
scenes.sub: Match each check to what it can show.
voice: KWOK can exercise Kubernetes deployment flows with simulated nodes.
GPU acceptance tests run selected workflows on real hardware, where checks can exercise capabilities the simulator cannot measure.
scenes.result: See which checks used real GPUs

scenes.heading: Count distinct signers
scenes.sub: Repeat runs still come from one source.
voice: The evidence dashboard groups signed results by recipe and counts distinct allowlisted signers.
Two runs from the first team still count as one source, alongside results from another signer.

scenes.heading: Read disagreement and gaps
scenes.sub: Filter to the AICR release you use.
voice: Choose a release in the dashboard to compare same-version results.
A contested row exposes disagreement, and an untested row shows that no allowlisted source ran that check.

payoff: Distinguish simulation, hardware testing, and independent evidence for one AICR version.
